claims.statement: EMA's ESMP collects shortage data from national authorities and marketing-authorisation holders and supports machine-to-machine interoperability.
Poland's GIF publishes weekly medicine-availability summaries for healthcare professionals based on multiple distribution-chain data sources.

contrary_evidence: Public reporting and ZSMOPL already aggregate extensive supply-chain data, reducing the value of a second shortage dashboard.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many distribution through independent-pharmacy buying groups and licensed wholesalers.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: reaching 2000 pharmacies at 250 PLN monthly blended revenue produces 6 million PLN ARR by year five, making majority founder equity plausibly exceed 5 million PLN without counting retained cash twice.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 4 founder hours daily for data integration and monitoring while pharmacists retain every clinical decision.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 65-80% gross margin after integration support, uptime, and pharmaceutical compliance review.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a 30000 PLN buying-group integration pays back within 12 months at 200 subscribing pharmacies.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 199 PLN per pharmacy monthly plus 2 PLN per verified shortage-resolution lookup paid by a buying group.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every failed order, replenishment cycle, and weekly shortage watch creates a repeat use event.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Contracted rights to aggregate failed, attempted, and fulfilled order events create local availability intelligence
fingerprint.customer: Independent Polish pharmacies and their purchasing groups
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Buying-group ordering platforms and licensed wholesaler integrations
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Non-clinical inventory routing and shortage forecasting sold as an embedded API
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: A pharmacy group pays for a verified availability lookup or recurring site access
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A prescribed product cannot be filled from the pharmacy's normal wholesaler

founder_fit: The opportunity uses health-domain interest and forecasting skill while buying groups replace high-touch pharmacy-by-pharmacy sales.
risks: Routing must stay within licensed distribution and never recommend therapeutic substitution or expose commercially sensitive stock.

structure.control_point: The failed medicine order and pharmacist-approved rerouting event
structure.critical_dependency: Near-real-time wholesaler inventory access and compliant pharmacy integrations

thesis: Embed pharmacist-controlled shortage routing in buying-group ordering software, charging for verified availability events while pooling lawful attempted-versus-fulfilled order signals into a local supply map unavailable from public notices alone.
title: PharmaFill Shortage Routing Network
uncertainties: Wholesaler willingness to license usable inventory and fulfillment signals is unvalidated.
